releases.title: Slice 04 · Reverse, steering & baked Travel contact
releases.summary: Drive one original Kenney kart in a bounded dry area of the actual baked Travel globe. Compare new reverse/brake controls with raw Slice-04 input on the same physics and terrain. Character and wider vehicle comparisons remain in the linked owner apps below.
releases.evidence: Source: 9 input tests + 19 Chromium browser checks passed; 81 dry support samples. This is a local contact probe, not completed Walk / Drive / Combat integration. Public-host verification is recorded separately in qa and GitHub Actions.
